Taylor — thanks for the clean copy and flags. Couple quick confirmations from our side:

- Redwood is fine accepting a notarized wet signature on the MSA if Acme prefers that route for internal compliance. We can then upload the notarized PDF to finish the DocuSign envelope as a post-sign clean copy.
- For the Order Form: we need the authorized signatory name + title on the signature page. If Procurement (you) signs via PO, legal still requires the named signee for our records.
- Routing preference: our standard process is to send a DocuSign envelope to the named signers first (electronic signature). If you want notarization, two options:
  1) You sign/notarize outside DocuSign and then send the notarized PDF to us to attach as final exhibit (fastest).
  2) We create a DocuSign envelope and include a "Needs Notary" step (we'll coordinate a local on-site notary or remote notarization depending on state). This takes slightly longer but keeps record continuity in one envelope.

Laura — can you confirm legal is OK with our accepting an externally notarized MSA and whether we should require a signed affidavit/witness statement as an extra artifact?

Taylor — if you can confirm preferred signer name/title and whether you want us to create the envelope with a notary step, we will prepare and route. We aim to close signature by end of week if possible.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik / Taylor — quick legal note from our side:

- Accepting an externally notarized MSA is fine, provided Acme produces the notarized PDF with the notary seal and the signed signature page. We also ask for a short cover affidavit if the notary's jurisdiction requires an additional proof-of-identity statement; otherwise the notarized PDF alone is sufficient.
- If Acme prefers to do remote online notarization inside the DocuSign envelope, please confirm the signer will be in a state that allows RON (remote online notarization) and we will add the DocuSign Notary workflow. That adds ~24–48 hours for identity verification on DocuSign's side.
- Please confirm the exact signatory name and title for the Order Form. For our records we need both the printed name and their corporate title spelled exactly as it will appear on the Order Form. If multiple folks must sign (e.g., Procurement + Finance), indicate the signing order.

Action items for Taylor:
- Confirm preferred approach: external notarized PDF or DocuSign + Notary.
- Confirm signer name(s) and signing order.
- If external notarization, attach the notarized PDF to a reply and label as "Final Executed MSA - Notarized".

We will not require witness signatures unless your internal counsel insists. If you elect DocuSign Notary, we'll create the envelope and share the link so you can complete identity verification.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
